title: feat(2d): Slot and Trochoidal Slot read DXF sketch chains
body: Stacked on #2716 (merge #2716 first) This branch starts at the head of #2716 (`2e77ca0ee`). The diff against `main` shows the changes of #2716 too, until #2716 merges. The changes of this PR are the one commit `feat(2d): Slot and Trochoidal Slot read DXF sketch chains`. ## What changed - A `Slot` and a `Trochoidal Slot` now take one picked chain of a DXF profile (`FeatureSel::SketchChain` or a `SketchLayer` that holds one chain). - One closed line-arc slot outline seeds `a`, `b` and `width`. - One open straight chain is the centerline. It seeds `a` and `b`. The typed `width` stays. - The pick seeds in its own command (`CreateOperation`, `SetOperationGeometry`). One undo takes back the pick and the seed. This is the law of #1504. - Generation judges the stored slot against the picked chain. A slot that left its outline is refused by name. A slot whose ends are not the ends of its centerline is refused by name. - The verification and the stock simulation use the setup stock (`part_solid = false`), as #2716 does for the 2D Contour. - The project file does not change. A `.camproj` file with a two-point slot opens and generates as before. These picks are refused by name: - a closed chain that is not a slot outline (a rectangle, a circle): "is not a slot outline"; - an open chain that is not straight: "the picked centerline is not straight"; - more than one chain: "a slot on a DXF profile cuts one chain, and this selection has 2 chains"; - the whole profile as the source: "needs one picked chain"; - a channel narrower than the tool. The `Slot` refusal now gives the slot width and the tool diameter. Files: - `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room_line.rs` (new): `SlotBound::from_centerline`, `SlotBound::centerline` and the ends law. - `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room.rs`: the `Room::Line` kind in each match of the room law. - `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slots.rs`: the numbers in the "slot is narrower than the tool" refusal. - `crates/app/src/operation/slot_sketch.rs` (new): resolves the picked chain to a slot room, and holds the outline test. - `crates/app/src/operation/slot_pick.rs`: `slot_bound_of` reads sketch picks; `slot_from_picks` and `confine_slot` include the `Trochoidal Slot` on sketch picks; `slot_fit_of` describes a centerline. - `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`: the job reads the slot room for a `Trochoidal Slot` on sketch picks, and its region is the authored stadium. - `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`: the `Trochoidal Slot` arm judges the slot against the slot room. - `crates/app/src/operation/material_region.rs`: the preview does not read sketch slot picks as a region. - `crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch_pick.rs`: `visit_src_chains` and `transform_chain_pts` are `pub(super)`. - `crates/app/src/sketch_model.rs`: the profile law admits picked chains for the two slot kinds. - `docs/decisions/1868-slot-dxf-sketches.md`: the decision. ## Cause `sketch_model::source_problem` refused picked chains of a profile for each kind but the 2D Contour. `slot_bound_of` refused sketch picks. The slot room had no centerline kind. ## Tests Pins, in `crates/app/tests/slot_dxf_sketch.rs`: - `a_slot_outline_seeds_the_slot_and_cuts_it_to_size` - `a_trochoidal_slot_reads_the_same_outline` - `an_open_straight_chain_is_the_centerline_at_the_typed_width` - `picks_that_are_no_slot_are_refused_by_name` Pins, in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room_pins.rs`: - `a_centerline_room_holds_its_two_ends_and_refuses_other_ends` - `a_bent_short_or_doubled_centerline_is_refused_by_name` The four app pins were red on the unchanged code. Each failed with "picked chains of a profile are not supported yet". Readings from the outline pin (4 mm tool, 10 mm outline, centres (45, 25) and (75, 25)): - seeded ends (45.000, 25.000) and (75.000, 25.000), width 10.000 mm; - cutter centre X 42.000 to 78.000 and Y 22.000 to 28.000; - stock simulation: 0 gouge cells. Mutation results. Each mutation removes one guard. Each made a pin red. The restored code is green. | Mutation | Result | |---|---| | M1 outline area test off | red (`picks_that_are_no_slot_are_refused_by_name`) | | M2 one-chain rule off | red (same pin) | | M3 centerline straightness test off | red (same pin) | | M4 centerline ends law off | red (`an_open_straight_chain_is_the_centerline_at_the_typed_width`) | | M5 slot room judge off in the `Trochoidal Slot` arm | red (`a_trochoidal_slot_reads_the_same_outline`) | | M6 whole-profile refusal off | red (`picks_that_are_no_slot_are_refused_by_name`) | | M7 old profile law back | red (all four app pins) | | M8 old "narrower than the tool" text back | red (`picks_that_are_no_slot_are_refused_by_name`) | | M9 doubled-back centerline test off | red (`a_bent_short_or_doubled_centerline_is_refused_by_name`) | | M10 sketch read off in `slot_bound_of` | red (all four app pins) | Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base base-2716` on head `bd24b9328`, where `base-2716` is the head of #2716 (`2e77ca0ee`). The gate ran in two parts (`--only motion --only "app build"`, then `--only "app suites" --only "ui build" --only "ui suites"`). Result: 645 steps, 644 green, 1 red. - The red step is `app suites: feature_edge_g1_join`, test `no_pickable_edge_is_a_tangent_piece_of_a_longer_one_in_any_step_fixture` ("bar_cross_holes.step: 116 pairs"). This is the known failure of #2713. Its fix (#2731, merge `b02b344d6`) is on `main` and is not in the branch of #2716. This PR changes no import code and no feature code. - I did not run the gate with `--base upstream/main`. On a stacked branch that plan has 916 steps. It tests #2716 and the changes on `main` after the base of #2716, not this commit. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean. ## Refresh with main (review of `bd24b9328`) `main` was merged into the branch (merge commits, no rebase). Main took project v73 for `do_not_touch` (#2055). The sketch picks and `chain_overrides` of #1864 now use v74: - `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`: `PROJECT_VERSION` is 74. A v73 reader refuses a file with sketch picks. - A v73 file steps up to v74 and keeps its `do_not_touch` protection. - `SetOperationGeometry` keeps the per-chain override seat and main's `do_not_touch` overlap refusal. Main's new code matches `FeatureSel` exhaustively. Git did not show these places as conflicts: - `Do not touch` refuses a sketch chain or layer pick by name, at the command and at generation. - The generation stamp hashes the two sketch variants. - Rotary picks refuse a sketch pick with the face-only refusal. - `corner_relief_sim` gives the sketch contour plan to `WcsYaw::enter`. - The UI overlay `avoid_viz` draws nothing for a sketch pick. - The two slot CL goldens take main's first-traverse `START` line (#2901). The moves did not change. - `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj` has version 74. New pins: - `do_not_touch_refuses_a_sketch_chain_or_layer_by_name` (`crates/app/tests/contour_dxf_sketch.rs`) - `protected_project_roundtrips_and_refuses_a_future_version` now opens a v73 file and checks the protection (`crates/app/tests/do_not_touch_project.rs`) - `layer_and_chain_picks_per_chain_overrides_undo_and_project_v74_roundtrip` checks the v74 barrier Mutations (each red, then green when restored): | Mutation | Result | |---|---| | `PROJECT_VERSION` back to 73 | red (`..._project_v74_roundtrip`: "sketch picks need the v74 format barrier") | | sketch-pick refusal off in `validate_do_not_touch` | red (`do_not_touch_refuses_a_sketch_chain_or_layer_by_name`) | | step-up refuses v73 | red (`protected_project_roundtrips_and_refuses_a_future_version`: "unsupported project version 73") | ### Gate on the combined head `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (falls back to batch, because geometry changed): 997 steps, 996 ok, 1 failed. The failed step was `app suites: continuous_4axis_part` (example file at v73). After the fix, `--failed` ran that step again: green. Clippy `-D warnings` on all touched crates: green. The two suites that the review named are green on the combined head: - `kernel suites: step_agreement`: ok - `app suites: feature_edge_g1_join`: ok ### Heavy lanes `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` reached the `motion heavy` and `app heavy` lanes (every target). Result: 234 steps, 233 ok, 1 failed. - The known-fail markers (#1950, #2845, #2849) were red as expected. - Failed: `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`, `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`, counts (3158, 3130, 1141). This is the open issue #3050: the same test is red on `main` with the same counts. This PR does not change the adaptive planner or the STEP mesh. ## Screenshots Geometry page, before (`main` at `768fe23f0`) and after (this head). The DXF profile has the layers `cut`, `holes` and `open`. 2D Contour: before / after Slot: before / after ## Goldens moved No existing golden changed. Two goldens are new (their `START` line follows main's first-traverse law, #2901): - `crates/app/tests/golden/slot_dxf_outline.cl` (9 moves) - `crates/app/tests/golden/trochoid_slot_dxf_outline.cl` ## Not exercised - A click on a sketch chain on a Slot page. The operation page echoes the slot room for a `Slot` only, not for a `Trochoidal Slot`. - The MCP door `set_operation_geometry` with a slot kind. It calls the same `SetOperationGeometry` command that the pin calls. - A posted NC program from a sketch slot. The post reads the same CL moves as a two-point slot. - A profile with a turned pose, and a WCS rotation. `SlotBound::rotated_xy` has a motion pin for the centerline room. - The messages of a judged sketch outline say "the picked face". That is the text of the face room. ## Not done (follow-up #2912) - A bent or arc centerline. It is refused by name. - A closed chain as a centerline (a circular groove). - More than one chain in one operation. The decision file gives the reasons. Issue #1868 "Done means" asks for line-arc slot sketches, named refusals and the two-point files. These are done. The diff against `main` changes the process file `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (from #2716). This PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. Process change: yes ## Overlaps - #2716 (stacked): `sketch_model::source_problem`, `sketch_model::generation_problem`, `collect_job` in `operation/job.rs`, `visit_src_chains` in `operation/contour_sketch_pick.rs`. - #2714 and #2836: they add `SlotUndercut` arms next to the `Trochoidal Slot` arm in `operation/generate.rs`. Different arm. Whichever merges second refreshes. - #2831: `machining2d::slot` in `slots.rs` and the `Slot` arm. This PR changes one refusal text in `slot`. Whichever merges second refreshes. - #2842: `slots.rs`, a different line. - #2890, #2822, #2853, #2892, #2678: `operation/generate.rs`, `operation/job.rs` or `operation/types/params.rs`, different functions. Changelog: Slot and Trochoidal Slot read a picked DXF sketch chain: a closed line-arc slot outline gives the ends and the width, an open straight chain gives the centerline; other picks are refused by name (#1868).
